description: Mandatory boundary test (Section 27, 'SG MCB crossing'): YTD qualifying earnings $270,000 before this payday, $2000 gross this period, crossing the $270,830 annual Maximum Contribution Base. Room = 270830-270000 = 830. Qualifying this period is capped at 830 (not the full 2000). SG = 830 * 12% = 99.60.
source: ZP-TAX-AU-2026-27-001 v1.0 Section 10 (Payday Super: SG 12%, Maximum Contribution Base $270,830) and Section 27.
